title: Neural networks for nonlinear regression with serially correlated disturbances: Evidence from cloud cover
abstract: arXiv:2606.22483v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a new treatment of nonlinear regression with serially correlated disturbances that incorporates autoregressive moving average structures into feedforward neural networks. The resulting model provides an alternative to modeling temporal dependence using lagged variables. In simulations, the proposed method accurately recovers regression functions of varying complexity and the underlying error dynamics across a range of time-series lengths and signal-to-noise ratios. Finite-sample properties and out-of-sample predictive performances are shown to be robust to model misspecification induced by omitted lagged variables and incorrect specification of the error dynamics. Cloud cover is an important factor in climate projections. translated_title: 具有序列相关扰动的非线性回归神经网络：来自云量的证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.22483v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们提出了一种处理具有序列相关扰动的非线性回归的新方法，该方法将自回归移动平均结构融入前馈神经网络中。所得模型为使用滞后变量建模时间依赖性提供了一种替代方案。在模拟中，所提出的方法能够准确恢复不同复杂度的回归函数以及在不同时间序列长度和信噪比范围内的潜在误差动态。有限样本性质和样本外预测性能被证明对因省略滞后变量和错误指定误差动态而导致的模型误设具有鲁棒性。云量是气候预测中的一个重要因素。在一项针对地中海及其周边网格位置的云量预测实证研究中，我们提出的模型比现有方法（包括长短期记忆网络）产生了更准确的预测。
tldr: 本文提出一种将自回归移动平均结构嵌入前馈神经网络的非线性回归新方法，用于处理序列相关扰动，在模拟和地中海云量预测实证中均优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel nonlinear regression method that embeds autoregressive moving average structures into feedforward neural networks to handle serially correlated disturbances, outperforming existing methods in simulations and empirical cloud cover prediction over the Mediterranean.
